name: Wesley Wong
tagline: High Schooler in Embedded Autonomous Systems
about:
Hi, I’m Wesley. I work at the intersection of embedded software, hardware design, and machine learning.

As co-founder and software lead for my school’s CubeSat team, I direct a 20-person software team and secured $10k in initial funding. Before this, I served as software director for FRC Team 972, leading our 50-member team to the World Championship Division Finals. My recent research centers on reinforcement learning for robotics—specifically designing training curricula to improve control stability—which was accepted to a NeurIPS workshop.

I’m a sophomore at Los Gatos High School with a 4.5 GPA (4.0 unweighted) where I plan workshops to help aspiring researchers get started as the Bay Area Exea Labs Ambassador.

experience.title: Bay Area Ambassador
experience.description: Connecting aspiring high school researchers with compute resources, publishing guidance, and STEM support across the Bay Area.

experience.title: Co-President, Software/AI Director
experience.description: Co-founded my high school's first CubeSat team. Lead the software subteam and conduct research on satellite attitude control via spiking neural networks on neuromorphic hardware. Raised $10k+ in grant funding.

experience.title: Independent Researcher
experience.description: Fully independent and sole author across multiple research efforts. Endorsed for ArXiv and accepted to the NeurIPS Workshop on Physical Understanding. Currently in journal submission with additional papers in progress on multimodal robotics, spiking neural networks, and machine learning.

experience.title: Director of Software
experience.description: Led a 50-member FRC team's software division. Won three awards including at the state championship, then placed as Division Finalist at the Houston World Championship.

projects.name: Functional Safety Project
projects.description: Exploring functional safety for robotics — anticipating failures so machines can safely coexist with humans. Building intuition through iterative safety-focused projects.

projects.name: Custom Robot & AUV Design
projects.description: Designing a practical and scalable multimodal robot from scratch. Creating the full stack: designing in Fusion, refining through Ansys, planned circuitry and parts, and STM32 embedded programming.

projects.name: Synopsys Science Fair — GPT-Controlled RL Pipeline
projects.description: AI-powered software engineering pipeline using GPT to decompose projects into structured tasks via prompt engineering and multi-stage validation. Placed 3rd in category at SCVSEFA.

projects.name: Self-Hosted GPU Cluster
projects.description: Scalable AI inference platform orchestrating on-demand GPUs via Vast.ai. Built with Google Cloud Run, Redis, and vLLM for low-latency model serving with automatic routing and caching.

projects.name: Computer Vision Programs (AUV, Face-ID)
projects.description: Applied and fine-tuned YOLO models for object detection across robotics and identification use cases.

projects.name: PCB Design & Embedded Systems (KiCad)
projects.description: Self-taught PCB design and embedded systems engineering. Designed custom STM32-based development boards from schematic capture through layout for robotics and CubeSat avionics.

projects.name: Local Image Generation & Finetuning (ComfyUI)
projects.description: Built custom node-based workflows for local image and video generation using Stable Diffusion and ComfyUI.
